title: •Rebel Planners
caption: •Rebel Planners (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect; and, once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under your Starting Effect. May not be canceled. {alter}
lore: Rebel strategists worked under master tactician General Dodonna. They devised an unorthodox battle plan to destroy the Death Star at the Battle of Yavin.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub expands 'Immune to Alter'). Slip text otherwise matches the stub. The wiki's default 'Rebel Planners' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Rebel Planners (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set, Premiere Limited). Two scans exist, both ~350 px: Premiere-L-rebelplanners-decipher-archive.gif (367×506, used as src) and Premiere-L-rebelplanners.gif (350×490, also downloaded as src/vs6/18-Premiere-L-rebelplanners.gif). Premiere: no expansion ring icon. Lore matches the scan. Copyright '1995' legible on the upscaled crop (Hoth-style line). No modern PC remake or Virtual Block image found on the wiki (modern null).
